next.reason: 1985: 'The OPEN statement with the I-O phrase must reference a file that supports the input and output operations that are permitted for an indexed file when opened in the I-O mode' and places the file in I-O open mode. §2023:14.9.27.4 GR16 'the file shall support the input and output statements that are permitted for the organization of that file when opened in the I-O mode' and sets the I-O open mode. Its '37' result restates 1985 status 37 c.2), already a separate 1985 rule; a run-time file property in both editions.
